message: 邪宗門が来る！

name: Nanaka
message: 「Today we're interviewing Shio-chan!」

name: Shio
message: 「A-An interview, you say!? Such a glorious occasion is a first for this humble self」

name: Shio
message: 「I may fall short in many respects, yet I humbly ask for your kind guidance and favor」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-If you're gonna be that formal...」

name: Synn
message: 「We're just going around gathering opinions on the Holy Night Festival, so no need to be so stiff」

name: Shio
message: 「The Student Council President himself is personally gathering the opinions of the common folk regarding a school event! That is no easy feat」

name: Synn
message: 「It's really not that big a deal. Besides, I only became Student Council President because everyone elected me. Calling yourselves 'common folk' and all that--」

name: Shio
message: 「Though I am an inexperienced novice who knows not left from right, I intend to answer with all my heart and soul. Now, ask whatever you wish」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... This is your first Holy Night Festival, right, Shio-chan」

name: Shio
message: 「Yes! As this will be my first time experiencing a pagan ritual, I intend to keep my eyes wide open and witness everything」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What about Halloween?」

name: Shio
message: 「Lady Nanaka. Originally, that was no pagan festival. It is a storied tradition that originated in this very land.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaaaat?!」

name: Shio
message: 「In the distant days of yore, a noble of the capital by the name of Haruoin was deeply moved by the rich nourishment of the pumpkin--」

name: Shio
message: 「And so it began when he held a festival to give thanks to the myriad gods for bestowing such a magnificent food upon us.」

name: Shio
message: 「This festival spread across the seas to foreign lands, and before anyone knew it, it came to be called Halloween.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uh... isn't that stretching things a bit?」

name: Shio
message: 「I am in robust health and all is well, so fret not.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What about Christmas?」

name: Shio
message: 「That has become an empty formality in this country, so it serves as no useful reference.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-um... the main thing here is the Holy Night Festival, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. The Holy Night Festival, the Holy Night Festival」

name: Shio
message: 「As it is a pagan festival, I am prepared for all manner of dreadful things to transpire. Most dreadful of all is the Sacrament」

name: Synn
message: 「Dreadful... things?」

name: Shio
message: 「From what I hear, the people of foreign lands sup upon the flesh and blood of their savior」

name: Shio
message: 「And furthermore, through necromancy they summon evil spirits down into the cathedral, chanting 'Eloim Essaim, Eloim Essaim'」

name: Shio
message: 「However, pray rest assured. Should any evil spirit appear, my Kogitsunemaru shall surely teach it a lesson」
Nanaka and I looked at each other.
Even without words, we understood.
She's hopeless.

name: Synn
message: 「Listen, Shio-chan. We don't do any terrifying rituals like that」

name: Shio
message: 「Is that truly so?」

name: Synn
message: 「Just like Christmas, it lost all its original meaning once it came to this country」

name: Shio
message: 「What! Could that really be true?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, totally. Besides, there's no way we could ever pull off some evil ritual like that」

name: Shio
message: 「Now that you mention it, that is quite true. There is no way Lord Synn could ever perform such wicked deeds. How shameful of me」

name: Shio
message: 「I suppose... things truly do lose their essence once they cross the sea」
Shio-chan looked somehow disappointed.
